The Linear Maze 0.5.0

A fast top-down shooter. A quiet morning on the 14th floor of an office tower, a door that wasn’t there before, three maze floors below it, and then the strange evening, night and morning at home.

To play, open index.html in a browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari). It needs a keyboard and mouse.
Made with the Linear Maze engine (engine/). The game itself is in games/linear-maze/.
